messages:
alex (PM): Quick sync — pilot onboarding checklist for Optimize toolkit. Customer asks: mobile-heavy small prompts, target p95 latency <300ms, target 30% token cost reduction. Need to confirm acceptance criteria + rollout plan. TL;DR: batching + prefix/KV caching + 4-bit quant fallback. Thoughts?

maria (Infra): p95 300ms is tight in hosted env. We can hit it with low-latency path (small-batch) + aggressive KV cache; expect 20–25% cost drop baseline. 4bit quant gives more but increases risk. Need eval gates and sample-level regressions.

sam (ML): Agree. Propose eval-triggered alerts: baseline prompt set (~200), thresholds: mean logprob delta <0.8, semantic-similarity drop <1.5pt. On fail, auto-fallback to fp16/float32 variant and flag for investigation.

jordan (Eng-ops): Ops note: to maintain p95 we want Dedicated or isolated nodepool for pilot. Otherwise autoscale cold starts and GC will push tail latency. Canary rollout + health-checks + automatic rollback after 1% error bump.

alex (PM): Draft launch gates:
- Perf gate: p95 <=300ms on prod-like traffic
- Econ gate: >=25% token cost reduction vs baseline
- Quality gate: eval pass (no class drop >2%)
Also need docs + dashboard and runbook.

ashley (SRE): SLI/SLO suggestions: p99 <=500ms (SLO), p95 <=300ms (SLO), error-rate <0.1% (SLO). Add metrics: batch_hit_rate, kv_cache_hit_rate, quant_fallback_rate, eval_regression_alert.

sam (ML): Quant plan: start with per-layer 4-bit PTQ on 1k prompts, hold out 50 problem prompts. If any intent-level metric drops >2pts, treat as fail. Fallback policy: if eval alerts fire >3x in 24h, revert quant for that tenant.

maria (Infra): Implementation phases:
1) Pilot (2 weeks): hosted w/ isolated pool; synthetic + small number of customers
2) Expand: limited beta customers, A/B cost telemetry
3) GA: docs, SDK flags, rollout playbook

alex (PM): Timeline: kickoff next Mon -> 3-week pilot -> sign-off. Owners: alex (PM) track, sam (ML) evals, maria (Infra) infra/rollout, jordan (Eng-ops) canary + RBAC. I'll write acceptance checklist.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: 1769990000 -> pilot/optimize-toolkit/canary

alex (PM): @sam @maria ping — can you confirm eval thresholds & phase plan by EOD Fri? I'll circulate acceptance checklist and customer onboarding email.

sam (ML): Will confirm thresholds today. Adding a sample eval config below:
```json
{"eval_set": "pilot_mobile_200", "thresholds": {"mean_logprob_delta": 0.7, "semantic_drop": 1.5}, "fallback": "fp16"}
```

maria (Infra): I'll own isolated pool + perf test harness. Sending perf script later today. :thumbsup:

alex (PM): Thanks — we'll sync Thursday 10am to finalize gates. :calendar:
